title: Pottery Shed
shortDescription: Clay freckles the wheels, the benches, and almost everything else.
longDescription:
Pottery wheels face the orchard light, surrounded by clay footprints and ambitious unfinished bowls. Cups dry on a rack above the sink, each one a slightly different answer to the question of what a cup should be.
A watering jug rests beside a lump of grey clay. The jug wears a painted rain cloud; its spout wears something much less useful.

fixtures.name: Watering Jug
fixtures.examineDescription: A collar of drying clay blocks most of the spout, and crumbs have fallen into the water inside. A workshop note reads: 'This jug is for rinsing clay tools. Please do not borrow it for the greenhouse.' Grey flecks match those caught in the seedling tray's drainage hole.
